authority.ordered_hash_contract: sha256 over each declared authority path as UTF-8, NUL, decimal byte length, NUL, raw file bytes, NUL, in chapter-closure order

line_locator_contract.meaning: one-based exact carrier-start line in the pinned authority source at the stated commit

carrier_contract.atomic_task: task element with no descendant task element
carrier_contract.grouping_task: task element with one or more descendant task elements; backend-only, not a prompt occurrence
carrier_contract.direct_statement: direct statement child of a taskless exercise, activity, or exploration
carrier_contract.direct_body: taskless activity or exploration with a direct p child and no direct statement

source_anchor_contract.sequence_scope: nearest real xml:id plus carrier label, in authority order

occurrence_entry_contract.alias_method: two hard-coded exact frozen file/XPath pairs

exercise.batch_derivation: exact authority-order canonical exercise-entry census partitioned into sequential batches of at most 10

prompt_map.row_semantics: one row per physical prompt occurrence
